description: Record a visit that arrived through an affiliate link. Use it only to track clicks from a server; the Affitor browser tracker does this on its own. Returns { ok, status, data }, where data holds click_id (store it in the affitor_click_id cookie), partner_code and cookie_window_days.

affiliateUrl.description: The full link the visitor arrived on, carrying the partner code in ?aff= (or ?via=), such as https://example.com/?aff=maya. The API needs it to find the partner; without it the call fails.

existingClickId.description: The visitor's current affitor_click_id, so a repeat visit keeps the same click id. Send only an id that this program's tracker set. Leave it out to get a new one.

pageUrl.description: The page the visitor landed on, if it differs from affiliateUrl. Leave it out to record affiliateUrl as the landing page.

referrerUrl.description: The page that linked to you (the HTTP Referer), stored with the click to show where traffic came from. Leave it out when there is none.

name: affitor_track_click
